newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee devaluation to help economy - bank.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee devaluation to help economy - bank.

text.p: State (central) Bank of Pakistan (SBP) governor Muhammad Yaqub said Tuesday's devaluation of the rupee against the dollar would strengthen the country's economy.
"This action is to strengthen and not to weaken the economy," he told a news conference after the devaluation, which his bank calculated at 3.65 percent but foreign bankers at 3.79.

The devaluation will have a nominal effect on inflation and foreign debt servicing, but will increase exports, end speculation in the dollar and attract more remittances from Pakistanis working abroad, he said.
